types.name: CollapsibleProps
types.doc: One region that opens and closes in place. The height follows the content on a spring, the content comes into focus as it arrives, and the chevron turns with it. Use it for optional detail next to its heading; for a set of related sections use an accordion.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the region is open. Pass it together with `onOpenChange` to control the state yourself.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the next state whenever the trigger is used.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the current state and ignores the trigger.

members.name: variant
members.doc: "card" draws one bordered surface around the trigger and the content; "plain" leaves both bare for your own layout.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.

members.name: children
members.doc: A `CollapsibleTrigger`, a `CollapsibleContent`, and anything that should stay visible between them.

members.name: hint
members.doc: Short supporting text shown under the label, such as a summary of what is inside.

members.name: hideChevron
members.doc: Removes the chevron, for triggers that carry their own affordance.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the padded inner element that holds the content.

members.name: children
members.doc: The content that opens and closes. It stays mounted, so fields inside keep their values.
